items.html: Therefore, from this blemish another blemish was also added, and it is that since the light of AA of Atzilut was blocked, it caused a diminution to the Nukva of ZA of Atzilut, and all her nine upper Sefirot departed from her, and there remained in her only the light of a single point alone. And then a correction was added and made to the Klipa of Atzilut, and it is that those nine Sefirot that departed from the Nukva of holiness were clothed in the nine first points of the Nukva of ZA of the Klipa of Atzilut, which is called Lilith the wicked, the wife of Samael the wicked, who is ZA of Atzilut of the Klipa.
